name: golden_v1
description: Shared golden dataset for the Python, TypeScript, and Rust eval harnesses (slice 0008). Each harness seeds every record in `seed`, resolves each `items[].expected_seed_ids` fixture id to the real id its own store() call returned, then scores recall@k/MRR/faithfulness/latency against that resolved ground truth. All three harnesses must embed `content`/`query` text with the identical naive hashing embedding shipped in cli/src/embed.rs (FNV-1a feature hashing into 128 dims, L2-normalized) so scores are comparable across languages.

seed.content: The user prefers dark mode and weekly digest emails.
On 2026-08-14 the user asked for a summary of the Q2 revenue report.
To deploy the staging environment, run `make deploy-staging` from the infra directory.
Database migrations must be applied with `alembic upgrade head` before starting the API server.
The user's primary programming language is Rust, with Python as a secondary language.
Current task: refactor the authentication middleware to support API key rotation.
On 2026-08-20 the user reported a bug where recall latency spiked above 2 seconds under load.
The user's team uses Linear for issue tracking and GitHub for code review.
Rolling back a deployment requires re-running the previous release's Docker image tag via `make rollback TAG=<tag>`.
